questions.question: Discuss how Liebig and Shelford law help in understanding organisms distribution.
questions.solution_html:
• • Liebig’s Law of Minimum states that an organism’s distribution depends on the
  • scarcest environmental factor. ((1mark))
  • • Shelford’s Law of Tolerance adds that organisms can survive only within certain
  • range of environmental conditions. ((1 mark))

questions.question: State difference between global warming and ozone depletion.
questions.solution_html:
• • Global warming is the rise in Earth’s average temperature due to increased
  • greenhouse gases ((1 mark))
  • • Ozone depletion is the thinning of the ozone layer caused by chemicals like CFCs
  • allowing more UV radiation to reach Earth ((1 mark)).
questions.final_answer: allowing more UV radiation to reach Earth ()
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: How does the Green Data Book differ in purpose from the Red Data Book?
questions.solution_html:
• • The Red Data Book lists endangered and threatened species to help in their
  • protection. ((1mark))
  • • The Green Data Book provides environmental and natural resource data to
  • support sustainable development and conservation planning. ((1 mark))
questions.final_answer: support sustainable development and conservation planning. ()

questions.question: Recall difference between desert and forest ecosystem.
questions.solution_html:
• Recall difference between desert and forest ecosystem.

  • adapted to dry conditions. ((1 mark))
  • • A forest ecosystem has high rainfall, dense vegetation, and rich biodiversity with
  • many plant and animal species. ((1 mark))
